title: The Ten Equations that Rule the World
author: David Sumpter

rights.note: The book is in copyright (Allen Lane, 2020). These lessons summarise it chapter by chapter in original wording, written from the text and checked against it: they follow its order, retell its stories and worked examples, and quote only a few short credited phrases. Charts are redrawn in our own art from the book's numbers; none of its figures are reproduced. Not reviewed by a lawyer.

ideas.name: The betting equation
ideas.can: Explain how the betting equation turns odds into a probability, why fitting α and β reveals a long-shot bias, and why a small edge only shows over many bets.
